---
name: create-instructions
description: Use this prompt to generate highly specific agent instructions files for the docs/ directory.
agent: Instructions Generator Agent
---

Based on the information provided about an architectural layer or coding standard, generate a concise and clear .md agent instructions file in markdown format within the docs/ directory. Make sure to use the filename if provided; otherwise, generate a suitable filename based on the content. Make sure to update the AGENTS.md file to include a reference to the newly created instructions file. If no information is provided, prompt the user to provide the details about the architectural layer or coding standard to document. Please ensure the generated content is accurate, well-structured, and easy to understand and ask for clarification if any information is ambiguous.
